question: Which of the following rivers does not flow in Punjab?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Brahmani__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brahmani River** is one of the major seasonal rivers of **Odisha** state.
 
• It is a **Peninsular river** and falls in the** Bay of Bengal**.
 
• Its length is about** 480 km** and **2nd longest river** of Odisha after **Mahanadi**.
 
• The Brahmani is formed by the **South Koel** and **Sankh rivers** coming together close to **Rourkela**, a significant industrial town.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **River (Ancient Name)**
 **About**
 
 

 **Chenab (Aksini)**
 
 
 
• Flows through** India and Pakistan.**
 
• One of the major rivers on **Punjab region**.
 
• Originates from **Lahaul valley, Himachal Pradesh** by two streams - **Chandra** and **Bhaga**.
 
• It flows **1,180 km** **in India** before entering into Pakistan.
 
• It is the **largest tributary** of **Indus river**.
 
 
 
 

 **Beas (Vipasha)**
 
 
 
• Originates from **Beas Kund** near **Rohtang Pass**.
 
• Enters Punjab plains and meets **Satluj** near** Harike Barrage**.
 
• **Pandoh Dam** is also built on Beas river.
 
• It generates hydroelectricity.
 
 
 
 

 **Ravi (Purushni)**
 
 
 
• Rises west of the **Rohtang Pass** in** Kullu, Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• It flows through the **Chamba valley**.
 
• It joins **Chenab** before entering Pakistan.
